parent_objective: audit artifact-only task/curriculum readiness diagnosis and choose next non-training route
blocked_by: M2238 classifies the repeated below-floor result as training_plateau_or_late_regression with task_curriculum_repair secondary
supersedes: making finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claims from readiness diagnosis

public_gates: M2239 must audit M2238 result_class, missing artifact count, route classification, and guardrails
M2239 must decide whether the next route is plateau/reward/curriculum repair, floor calibration, or artifact-gap handling
M2239 must keep controller-family ranking, winner selection, finite-window-vs-GRU, paper-level, and self-ID claims blocked
M2239 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or training
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M2238 artifact-only route classification and chooses the next non-training repair route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2238 artifacts are missing
stop if route classification is inconsistent with row diagnostics
stop if the audit would proceed to another blind budget escalation
fallback_plan: route to artifact-gap repair if M2238 is incomplete
route to task/curriculum/reward/termination repair design if plateau/curriculum signals hold
route to floor calibration audit only if near-floor evidence dominates
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2238 completed with explicit route classification

training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2238 artifact-only readiness diagnosis result
admission_evidence: M2238 guardrail keeps training, rollout, ranking, paper claims, and self-ID claims false
allowed_updates: M2239 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2238 completeness and guardrails are audited
M2238 route classification is accepted, refined, or rejected
next route is selected without rerun or ranking claims

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2239 audits readiness diagnosis artifacts and does not test causal history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2239; no wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-history, or measured execution intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2230/M2234 training artifacts summarized by M2238.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2238 confirms below-floor training instability, route to repair design rather than lowering self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns repeated below-floor matched-budget training into a route decision before any further training
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether current-sim profile comparison is blocked by training instability, task/curriculum design, or floor calibration
must_synthesize_if: M2239 recommends another blind budget escalation

hypothesis: M2238 provides enough artifact-only evidence to audit the repeated below-floor result and route away from blind budget escalation.
success_criteria: guardrails remain false for rollout, training, PPO, ranking, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2239 starts new training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2239 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2239 makes finite-window-vs-GRU, paper-level, or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual artifact audit of runs/m2238_paper_route_current_sim_task_curriculum_readiness_diagnosis/summary.json and diagnostic CSVs

decision_rule: M2239 passes if it audits M2238 completeness and route classification, then selects a non-ranking follow-up route.
